pages.text: Transporting liquid matter through ethereal space adheres to the laws of harmonic resonance. By focusing on a $(l:create:fluid_pipe)Create Pipe$(), the caster tethers it to a designated dimensional fluid channel.$(br2)Linked pipes synchronize fluid contents instantaneously regardless of distance.
Transmutes the pipe into a $(l:arcane_bridge:phase_fluid_tx)Phase Emitter (TX)$(). Any fluid pumped into this node is fed directly into the ether network.
Transmutes the pipe into a $(l:arcane_bridge:phase_fluid_rx)Phase Receiver (RX)$(). Allows external pumps to draw fluids out from the ether network.
